title: SpatialWorld: Benchmarking Interactive Spatial Reasoning of Multimodal Agents in Real-World Tasks
title_zh: SpatialWorld：面向真实世界任务的多模态智能体交互式空间推理基准
abstract_en: Spatial reasoning is a foundational capability for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perceive and operate within the physical world. However, existing benchmarks predominantly rely on passive evaluation (e.g., static VQA) or simulator-specific pipelines, failing to assess general interactive spatial understanding. We introduce SpatialWorld, a unified benchmark designed specifically for evaluating the interactive spatial understanding of multimodal agents in complex real-world tasks. Integrating eight heterogeneous simulation backends under a shared, simulator-agnostic protocol, SpatialWorld features 760 human-annotated tasks across diverse domains (e.g., household routines, travel, social collaboration). Agents must solve tasks under vision-only partial observability, actively gathering egocentric visual evidence and expressing decisions via a unified, text-based action interface native to MLLMs. For reliable evaluation, each task includes a human-validated initial state, a reference trajectory, and a terminal-state verifier. Evaluating 15 advanced agents reveals that robust spatial task solving remains challenging: the strongest model, GPT-5, achieves an average task success rate (TSR) of only 17.4%, while the leading open-source model, Qwen-3.5, reaches 14.1%. Further analysis exposes a clear mismatch between task success and execution efficiency, alongside substantial domain-specific performance variations. These bottlenecks in active exploration and long-horizon planning position SpatialWorld as a rigorous testbed for future spatial agents.
abstract_zh: 空间推理是多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）感知并操作物理世界的基础能力。现有基准多依赖静态 VQA 等被动评测，或绑定特定模拟器流程，难以衡量通用的交互式空间理解能力。本文提出 SpatialWorld，一个统一基准，用于评估多模态智能体在复杂真实世界任务中的交互式空间理解。SpatialWorld 在共享的、与模拟器无关的协议下整合了 8 个异构仿真后端，包含 760 个由人工标注的任务，覆盖家庭日常、旅行、社交协作等多种场景。智能体需要在仅视觉、部分可观测条件下主动收集第一视角视觉证据，并通过 MLLM 原生的统一文本动作接口做出决策。为保证评测可靠性，每个任务都提供人工验证的初始状态、参考轨迹和终止状态验证器。对 15 个先进智能体的评测显示，鲁棒空间任务求解仍十分困难：最强模型 GPT-5 的平均任务成功率（TSR）仅为 17.4%，领先开源模型 Qwen-3.5 达到 14.1%。进一步分析发现，任务成功率与执行效率存在明显不匹配，不同领域之间性能差异也很大。SpatialWorld 揭示了主动探索与长程规划的瓶颈，可作为未来空间智能体研究的严格测试平台。
key_points_zh: 提出 SpatialWorld，用于评估多模态智能体在复杂真实世界任务中的交互式空间推理，而非仅依赖静态 VQA 或特定模拟器。
基准整合 8 个异构 simulation backends，采用统一且 simulator-agnostic 的协议，包含 760 个跨家庭、旅行、社交协作等领域的人工标注任务。
智能体在 vision-only partial observability 下行动，需要主动探索第一视角视觉信息，并通过统一的文本动作接口完成决策。
每个任务配备人工验证初始状态、reference trajectory 和 terminal-state verifier，以提升评测可靠性与可复现性。
15 个先进智能体表现普遍较低：GPT-5 平均 TSR 仅 17.4%，Qwen-3.5 为 14.1%，暴露出主动探索、执行效率与长程规划的关键瓶颈。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong reusable benchmark for interactive embodied spatial agents, though it is less focused on realtime latency or speech/video tool workflows.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一个面向交互式具身空间智能体的高价值可复用基准，但对实时延迟和语音/视频工具流程关注较少。
